=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:54 and 72-80 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The reusable workflow's job-level `if` conditions gate on `vars.CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_ENABLED == 'true'`, which requires the repo variable to be explicitly set to the string `'true'`. When the variable is unset (the default-on scenario), `vars.CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_ENABLED` evaluates to null/empty, and `null == 'true'` is false — both jobs are skipped.
  WHY: A consumer repo that has not set `CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_ENABLED` at all (the intended default-on case) will have its wrapper job dispatch to the reusable workflow, but the reusable workflow's jobs will be silently skipped because `vars.CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_ENABLED == 'true'` evaluates false. The feature is effectively disabled by default, contradicting the PR's stated intent of default-on.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:53-60 and 80-87 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `if` conditions still use `vars.CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_ENABLED == 'true'` but the intent was to make this default-on. The env block sets a default of `'true'` but this only affects steps inside the job, NOT the `if` condition evaluation. When a consumer repo does NOT set the `CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_ENABLED` variable, the condition evaluates to `'' == 'true'` which is false, causing the workflow to skip entirely.
  WHY: For consumer repos that don't explicitly set `CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_ENABLED`, the workflow will never run because the `if` condition fails. This contradicts the stated goal of making the feature default-on.
- .github/workflows/internal-check-failure-triage.yml:16-22 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The internal self-hosting workflow still uses the old gate `vars.CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_ENABLED == 'true'` without any default. Unlike the consumer template that was updated to use `!= 'false'`, this file was not updated in the last run.
  WHY: For repos using the internal workflow (like the source repo itself), the check-failure triage will NOT run unless `CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_ENABLED` is explicitly set to `true`, even though the documentation claims it's "on by default".
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
